model_answer:
1. Fill with water through the open high-point vent until bubble-free water exits.
2. Close the vent; pressurize to $6.00\,\mathrm{bar}$ gauge.
3. Isolate the hand pump, then start the timer.
4. Hold for $300\,\mathrm{s}$ without adding water; observe for leakage.
5. Pass only with pressure drop $\leq0.20\,\mathrm{bar}$ and no visible leakage; otherwise fail. Logged drop: $6.00-5.90=0.10\,\mathrm{bar}$, with no leakage: PASS.
6. Open the release valve, confirm $0\,\mathrm{bar}$ gauge, then disconnect.
